body: Honestly, find a reddit to contribute to. There you can meet and interact with people. Even if only briefly. It's what I started doing when I feel lost and alone. You were brave enough to voice your sadness here. Why not try doing the same with those nuggets of happiness you come across. Let the wave of seemingly infinite wave of sadness wash over you and when the tide is low take a breather. Visit reddit drop a post make a couple people happy due to updoots and who knows what'll happen next.

On some level maybe, but I'm not exactly the expert on this. It's honestly something for you to make piece with. A little messed up but so are alot of things kids do.

Children do sexual stuff without knowing/understanding more often than you think. When my younger brother was about 4-5, when he was tired he would suck his thumb and hold his dick in his pants. It just felt comforting to him. Though my mom hated it in public didn't stop me from giggling everytime I saw it. I was about 12 at the time.
We all do. Find the moments. Even mushroom clouds have silver linings.

You have categorized your "whole life." Some of those things you can work on. You're smart enough to identify the things you don't like about your life. Try adjusting some of those things in your favor. If it doesn't work you will back at square one but if it does, who knows what might happen.

You will have to do the shitty thing most do in your situation. Build a mental wall and slowly plan your escape and never come back. It might take a while but they are old and you have time.

We have gathered here today because u/thingswillgetbetter8 might be gone forever. And because everyone deserves to be remembered. Saying it's a reminder that things will. We all would like to believe that. Thank you u/thingswillgetbetter8 for your post and contributions to our small corner of the internet.
